proposed_urls.rationale: 120C-100 Definitions: foundational definitions for the lobbying chapter.
120C-101 Rules and forms: rulemaking authority and prescribed forms for lobbying registration/reporting.
120C-102 Request for advice: advisory-opinion mechanism under the lobbying chapter.
120C-103 Lobbying education program: chapter-internal education/resource provision.
120C-104 Chapter applies to candidates for certain offices: scope extension of the lobbying chapter.
120C-200 Lobbyist registration procedure: core lobbyist-registration section.
120C-201 Lobbyist's registration fee: registration-fee provision.
120C-206 Lobbyist principal's authorization: principal-side authorization tied to lobbyist registration.
120C-207 Lobbyist principal's fees: principal-side fee provision.
120C-210 Resignation and termination: termination of registration.
120C-215 Other persons required to register: scope-extension registration requirement (present at 2015, not in 2025).
120C-220 Publication and availability of registrations: disclosure/transparency of registration filings.
120C-300 Contingency fees prohibited: lobbying-conduct prohibition.
120C-301 Election influence prohibited: lobbying-conduct prohibition.
120C-303 Gifts by lobbyists and lobbyist principals prohibited: gift ban core to lobbying disclosure regime.
120C-304 Restrictions: lobbying-conduct restrictions.
120C-305 Prohibition on the use of cash or credit of the lobbyist: lobbying-conduct prohibition.
120C-400 Reporting of reportable expenditures: core lobbying-expenditure reporting requirement.
120C-401 Reporting generally: general reporting framework.
120C-402 Lobbyist's reports: lobbyist-side report content/timing.
120C-403 Lobbyist principal's reports: principal-side report content/timing.
120C-404 Solicitor's reports: solicitor-side reporting (present at 2015, not in 2025).
120C-405 Report availability: public availability of filed reports.
120C-500 Liaison personnel: registration/reporting regime for state-agency liaison personnel.
120C-501 Applicability of Chapter on liaison personnel: how the lobbying chapter applies to liaison personnel.
120C-502 Local government liaison equivalents: extension of liaison rules to local-government equivalents.
120C-600 Powers and duties of the Secretary of State: chapter-internal administering authority.
120C-601 Powers and duties of the Commission: enforcement authority of the Ethics Commission over lobbying.
120C-602 Punishment for violation: penalty provision for violations of the lobbying chapter.
120C-603 Enforcement by district attorney and Attorney General: criminal-enforcement pathway for lobbying violations.
120C-700 Persons exempted from this Chapter: statutory exemptions from the lobbying registration/reporting regime.
120C-800 Reportable expenditures made by persons exempted or not covered by this Chapter: residual reporting requirement for otherwise-exempt actors.

notes: NC 2015 vintage available on Justia; full Method A pass-1/2/3 cleared CF cleanly on Dans-MacBook-Pro (Method A retry after the 5/19 NC 2015 pass-3 CF wall and the 5/26 Dans-MacBook-Air pass-1 CF wall). NC's lobbying-disclosure regime sits in standalone Chapter 120C of the General Statutes (the post-2006 ethics-reform consolidation, already in place by 2015). Chapter 138A (State Government Ethics Act, officials-side) intentionally excluded; Chapter 120 (General Assembly) contained the pre-2006 Article 9A lobbying regime but is irrelevant post-reform. Tree is 5 levels deep: state -> vintage -> chapter -> article -> section. Eight articles (1-8) enumerated, identical article-set to the 2025 successor. Total 32 section URLs proposed across all 8 articles. Excluded 120C-302 (Article 3): explicitly marked on the Justia anchor as 'Recodified as G.S. 163-278.13C' (campaign-finance regime, out of scope), same exclusion applied at NC 2025. Two sections present at 2015 but NOT in the 2025 successor: 120C-215 (Other persons required to register, Article 2) and 120C-404 (Solicitor's reports, Article 4) -- both within-chapter lobbying-disclosure scope, retained as core_chapter. Article 6 section 120C-601 was retitled between vintages ('Powers and duties of the Commission' at 2015 -> 'Additional powers and duties of the Commission' at 2025) but the section number persists. All proposed URLs are core_chapter (entire Chapter 120C is lobbying-disclosure-only, no support_chapter needed).
